work.description: The act founds the Senigallia college and entrusts it to the Jesuits. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF19267-19272 reads: Datum Romae apud Sanctam Mariam Majorem Anno Incarnationis Dominicae Millesimo Octingente- simo Quinquagesimo Tertio Kalendis Septembris Pon- tificatus Nostri Anno Octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
